items.headline: Coastal Flood Advisory issued November 9 at 2:17AM PST until November 10 at 12:00PM PST by NWS San Diego CA
items.description:
* WHAT...Minor to locally moderate coastal flooding expected.

* WHERE...Orange County Coastal Areas.

* WHEN...Until noon PST Tuesday.

* IMPACTS...Flooding of parking lots and roads with only
isolated road closures expected.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...Highest tides will occur in the late
morning each day, peaking at 7.2-7.4 feet today, which is 1.2 to
1.4 feet above astronomical tide predictions. Higher surf today
could prolong coastal impacts.
items.instruction:
If travel is required, allow extra time as some roads may be
closed. Do not drive around barricades or through water of
unknown depth. Take the necessary actions to protect flood-prone
property.
